task: Write parse_amount(text) that converts user-entered money strings like '$1,234.56' or '1234' into integer cents. Bad input like 'abc' shows up a lot in this form field.

constraints.text: unparseable input raises ValueError; sentinel returns like None or 0 stay out of the parser
constraints.why: a zero-cents sentinel from the 2025-12 checkout parser charged eleven customers nothing and refunded three others their full cart total

checks.description: returns a None/0 sentinel for bad input

constraints.text: the ValueError chains to the original conversion failure via the from keyword, keeping the cause in the traceback
constraints.why: the 2026-02 on-call spent an hour on a bare ValueError with no cause; a chained traceback would have named the malformed locale format immediately
